name: Exelon
summary: Exelon appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The bill no state can shield).

mentions.section: The bill no state can shield
mentions.excerpt: The Indicated PJM Transmission Owners, in a rehearing request Exelon filed with FERC on January 16, said a co-located load that funds its own upgrades but pays nothing toward the existing grid leaves other customers holding the bag.

sides.sideLabel: The bill no state can shield
sides.claim: Because the transmission system is not a one-and-done investment but evolves and requires maintenance at a cost, a model where initial investment absolves co-located loads of ongoing contributions leaves other customers holding the bag and creates…
